name: Bark Bite
summary: A friend asks you to soothe Fraxinus, an old tree spirit burned in the wars. The poultice may ease his pain for a little while.

sections.title: Fraxinus's Wounds
sections.body: The poultice is meant for Fraxinus, whose bark is split and whose sap weeps. His friend says the old tree spirit was badly burned in the wars, and that his bark and limbs still hurt. You are asked to apply the medicine to his wounds.

sections.title: A Little Relief
sections.body: Fraxinus says the fel taint in Hyjal festers in his roots and bark. The poultice soothes his old wounds, and for a little while his weak roots and branches are without pain. He is willing to call you friend.

faq.answer: Fraxinus is an old tree spirit who was burned in the wars and now suffers pain in his bark and limbs.
Fraxinus was badly burned in the wars, and he says fel taint in Hyjal festers in his roots and bark.
The poultice soothes Fraxinus's wounds and eases his pain for a little while.

faq.q: Who asks you to help Fraxinus?
faq.answer: A friend of Fraxinus makes the poultice from ingredients you brought and asks you to apply it to his wounds.
The poultice soothes Fraxinus, leaving his roots and branches free of pain for a little while.
